sections.title: Adventure in Provence: 11-Day Art, Culture & Heritage Journey
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Adventure in Provence: 11-Day Art, Culture & Heritage Journey

Experience the creative spirit of France, from Parisian landmarks and Cézanne’s studio to mosaic art, Mediterranean landscapes and the traditions of Provence.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Paris
sections.html:
Arrive in Paris

Arrive in Paris and settle into your accommodations. Enjoy time to explore the neighborhood at your own pace and discover the atmosphere of the French capital.

sections.title: Day 2 - Paris: Montmartre and Historic Treasures
sections.html:
Panoramic sightseeing drive in Paris

Discover Paris on a panoramic sightseeing drive.

Explore Montmartre, Sacré-Cœur Basilica, and Place du Tertre

Explore Montmartre, the Sacré-Cœur Basilica and artists’ Place du Tertre.

Île de la Cité, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and Sainte-Chapelle

Continue toward Île de la Cité to admire Notre-Dame Cathedral and visit the exquisite stained-glass chapel of Sainte-Chapelle.

Evening at leisure

The evening is yours to enjoy.

sections.title: Day 3 - High-Speed Train to Provence
sections.html:
High-speed train to Provence

Travel south by high-speed train to Provence and continue to Aix-en-Provence.

Settle in and free time in Aix-en-Provence

Settle in and enjoy free time to wander its elegant streets, fountains, cafés and lively squares.

sections.title: Day 4 - Cézanne and Contemporary Mosaics
sections.html:
Browse the Grand Market of Aix-en-Provence

Browse the colorful Grand Market of Aix-en-Provence.

Visit Atelier de Cézanne

Visit the Atelier de Cézanne, where the artist worked.

Meet mosaic artist Larissa Perekrestova-Clion in Peyrolles

Travel to Peyrolles to meet mosaic artist Larissa Perekrestova-Clion, visit her studio and discover examples of her work around the village.

sections.title: Day 5 - Camargue: Landscapes and Traditions
sections.html:
Scenic boat excursion in the Camargue

Journey to the Camargue for a scenic boat excursion through this distinctive southern landscape.

Visit a traditional manade (ranch)

Visit a traditional manade (ranch) and enjoy a special regional meal accompanied by flamenco music and dance.

Regional meal with flamenco music and dance

Enjoy a special regional meal accompanied by flamenco music and dance at a traditional manade.

Visit Le Grau-du-Roi

Spend time in the seaside town of Le Grau-du-Roi before returning to Aix.

sections.title: Day 6 - Cassis and Marseille
sections.html:
Explore Cassis harbor and waterfront

Discover the Mediterranean charm of Cassis, with time to explore its harbor and waterfront.

Guided visit of Mucem in Marseille

Continue to Marseille for a guided visit of Mucem, the Museum of European and Mediterranean Civilisations.

Free time in Marseille

Enjoy free time in the city of Marseille after your guided visit.

sections.title: Day 7 - Arles and the World of Van Gogh
sections.html:
Guided walking tour of Arles inspired by Van Gogh

Explore Arles on a guided walking tour inspired by Vincent van Gogh.

Discover Arles' Roman heritage and amphitheater

Discover the city’s Roman heritage, including its famous amphitheater.

Lunch and independent exploration in Arles

Enjoy time for lunch and independent exploration before returning to Aix for a relaxed afternoon.

sections.title: Day 8 - Art, Architecture and Provençal Flavors
sections.html:
Visit Château La Coste for art and architecture trail

Visit Château La Coste for a guided walk through its art-and-architecture trail and a wine tasting.

Lunch at leisure

Enjoy lunch at leisure.

Cheese tasting at a local farm

Stop at a local farm for a cheese tasting.

Evening in Aix-en-Provence

Return to Aix-en-Provence for an evening in town.

sections.title: Day 9 - Return to Paris and Seine Dinner Cruise
sections.html:
High-speed train to Paris

Travel back to Paris by high-speed train.

Seine dinner cruise

In the evening, enjoy a special dinner aboard a boat on the Seine, followed by a scenic cruise past the city’s illuminated landmarks.

sections.title: Day 10 - Paris at Leisure or Optional Chartres Excursion
sections.html:
Paris at Leisure or Optional Chartres Excursion

Enjoy a free day to explore Paris independently. Alternatively, join an optional excursion to Chartres, with a stop at Rudolf Nureyev’s grave, a guided visit of Chartres Cathedral and a visit to the remarkable mosaic-covered Maison Picassiette.

sections.title: Day 11 - Au Revoir, France
sections.html:
Breakfast

After breakfast, conclude your journey and make your onward travel arrangements.

Departure from France

Conclude your journey and make your onward travel arrangements.
